articleDraft.title: Adjustement Of The Cryptologic Technician-Maintenance Rating To The Reserve Component
articleDraft.summary: Navy Manpower Analysis Center (NAVMAC) is authorized to make appropriate changes in the Total Force Manpower Management System (TFMMS). In line with reference (a), this NAVADMIN directs revision of the Cryptologic Technician-Maintenance (CTM) rating into the Reserve Component.
articleDraft.whyItMatters: In line with reference (a), this NAVADMIN directs revision of the Cryptologic Technician-Maintenance (CTM) rating into the Reserve Component.
articleDraft.details:
In line with reference (a), this NAVADMIN directs revision of the Cryptologic Technician-Maintenance (CTM) rating into the Reserve Component. The adjusted service ratings will apply to Selected Reserve (SELRES) Sailors and billets.

Navy Manpower Analysis Center (NAVMAC) is authorized to make appropriate changes in the Total Force Manpower Management System (TFMMS).

If required, SELRES personnel realignment will be coordinated by BUPERS-

Points of contact for revision are as follows: a. Enlisted Community Manager (BUPERS 3152): (1) CDR Christopher Reid, SELRES Enlisted Community Manager christopher.r.reid8.mil@us.navy.mil (2) ISCM Brad Hayes, SELRES Enlisted Community Manager Bradrick.w.hayes.mil@us.navy.mil
